  • Classes in edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist used by edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist
    Class
    Description
    HighScoreTable
    The best HighScoreTable.CAPACITY runs, highest score first.
    HighScoreTable.Entry
    One finished run.
    LifetimeStats
    Totals across every finished run (tutorials excluded), kept in a simple key=value text file by SaveStore.
    RunRecord
    Everything needed to recreate a run: the seed, difficulty, player name, and every action taken.
    SaveStore
    Reads and writes the game's files in one directory (by default ~/.halls7800): "current-run.txt" — the saved, unfinished run "last-run.txt" — the record of the most recently finished run, kept for bug reports "scores.txt" — the high-score table "achievements.txt" — achievements earned in any run "lifetime-stats.txt" — totals across all finished runs
